description.html: At 90x50x50 cm and 225 liters, this terrarium offers a clean glass space with decorative film on the outside. The film is functional: it stops animals from seeing their reflection and reduces stress, while helping the terrarium blend into your home.

The horizontal layout with 90 cm of length gives a floor area where a basking zone, a cool zone and a hiding area are easy to arrange. This layout is key for reptiles because it lets them choose the temperature they are exposed to. The ventilation system with a protective mesh keeps fresh air flowing and prevents moisture buildup.

When ordering, you choose the film pattern and the shape of the 3D background. We handmake all our terrariums in Novi Sad, so customization is always possible, from dimensions to the way it opens. We ship by courier throughout Serbia.
